head: Final Cut Pro 13 update adds MotionVFX effects for Creator Studio
dek: Final Cut Pro 13 now includes thousands of MotionVFX themes, transitions, titles and effects, which used to cost up to 350 dollars a year on their own. The new features are only in the Creator Studio version, not the one-time purchase.
details: Apple bought MotionVFX in March. The update also adds the Content Hub with stock video, photos and graphics, image generation from a text description with a round trip to Pixelmator Pro, finer keyframing and easing, more transcription languages and a command that detaches a clip from the main storyline. MacRumors says Apple's outage on 17 November held the release back for a while. Creator Studio costs 12.99 dollars a month or 129 dollars a year and also includes Logic Pro, Motion, Compressor and Pixelmator Pro.
where: Mac, Final Cut Pro in Creator Studio; not in the one-time purchase version
means: If you edit on Final Cut Pro through Creator Studio, a large effects library comes with your subscription now. If you bought the app once, these additions aren't included.
todo: Update Final Cut Pro from the Mac App Store and look for the MotionVFX content and the Content Hub. Before buying effect packs elsewhere, check what's already included.
